spec.description: ocr-stage1 (172.16.24.168): host and container health, plus route health for vibranium, with drill-down into its logs and traces.

spec.expr: max by (dimension) (netdata_system_cpu_percentage_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension!="idle"})

spec.description: Host CPU by state, stacked (idle not shown). The stack height is the CPU busy %.
spec.title: CPU

spec.description: Host RAM split into used, cached, buffers and free (stacked). The stack height is total RAM.
spec.title: Memory

spec.expr: max by (device, dimension) (abs(netdata_disk_io_KiB_persec_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance"})) * 1024
max by (device) (netdata_disk_util___of_time_working_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance"})

spec.description: Read and write throughput for each block device (left axis), and % of time the device was busy (dashed, right axis).
spec.title: Disk I/O & busy %

spec.expr: max by (mount_point, filesystem) (100 * sum by (host, mount_point, filesystem) (netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension="used"}) / sum by (host, mount_point, filesystem) (netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension=~"used|avail"}))
max by (mount_point, filesystem) (sum by (host, mount_point, filesystem) (netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension="used"})) * 1073741824
max by (mount_point, filesystem) (sum by (host, mount_point, filesystem) (netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension="avail"})) * 1073741824

max by (mount_point, filesystem) (100 * sum by (host, mount_point, filesystem) (netdata_disk_inodes_inodes_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension="used"}) / sum by (host, mount_point, filesystem) (netdata_disk_inodes_inodes_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension=~"used|avail"}))

spec.description: Each mounted filesystem. Used % is computed like `df` (used / (used + avail)); Size includes space reserved for root.

spec.expr: max by (container_name, image, state) (label_replace(netdata_docker_container_state_state_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance"} == 1, "state", "$1", "dimension", "(.*)"))
max by (container_name, health) (label_replace(netdata_docker_container_health_status_status_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance"} == 1, "health", "$1", "dimension", "(.*)"))
max by (container_name) (sum by (host, container_name) (label_replace(netdata_cgroup_cpu_percentage_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance"}, "container_name", "$1", "cgroup_name", "(.*)")))

max by (container_name) (sum by (host, container_name) (label_replace(netdata_cgroup_mem_usage_MiB_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension="ram"}, "container_name", "$1", "cgroup_name", "(.*)"))) * 1048576

spec.description: Each Docker container: state, healthcheck status, current CPU (100% = one core) and memory.

spec.expr: max by (container_name) (sum by (host, container_name) (label_replace(netdata_cgroup_cpu_percentage_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance"}, "container_name", "$1", "cgroup_name", "(.*)")))

spec.description: CPU for each container (user + system). 100% = one full core.
spec.title: Container CPU

spec.expr: max by (container_name) (sum by (host, container_name) (label_replace(netdata_cgroup_mem_usage_MiB_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension="ram"}, "container_name", "$1", "cgroup_name", "(.*)"))) * 1048576

spec.description: RAM used by each container (cgroup usage, swap excluded).
spec.title: Container memory

spec.expr: sum by (status) (rate(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Response time across the selected routes. Percentiles come from histogram buckets (≤ 10 s). avg is sum ÷ count, so it is exact even above 10 s.
spec.title: Latency percentiles

spec.expr: max(sum by (host) (netdata_system_cpu_percentage_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension!="idle"}))

spec.description: All non-idle CPU time (user + system + iowait + steal + irq…), whole host.

100 * (sum(rate(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics", status=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum(rate(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Share of requests returning 5xx (server faults) and 4xx (client errors). There is no point when no traffic arrives.

spec.expr: sum by (method, path) (increase(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range]))

sum by (method, path) (increase(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics", status=~"2.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (method, path) (increase(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range]))

sum by (method, path) (increase(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (method, path) (increase(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range]))

sum by (method, path) (increase(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (method, path) (increase(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range]))

100 * (sum by (method, path) (increase(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics", status=~"4..|5.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (method, path) (increase(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range]))) / sum by (method, path) (increase(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range]))

sum by (method, path) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range])) / sum by (method, path) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_count{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range]))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (method, path, le) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (method, path, le) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (method, path, le) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__range])))

spec.description: One row per method + route over the selected time range. Click a path to filter the whole dashboard to that route (logs and traces included). Routes with no requests in the range are hidden. p95 and p99 are capped at 10 s (the highest histogram bucket); Avg is exact.
spec.title: Route scorecard — click a route for its trends or its logs & traces

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (path, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description: p95 response time for each route (≤ 10 s, the highest bucket). Gaps mean the route had no traffic.
spec.title: p95 latency by route

spec.expr: sum by (path, status) (rate(http_requests_total{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Requests per second for each route + status code. Each series name starts with its status, so 4xx is orange and 5xx is red.
spec.title: Responses by route & status

spec.expr: {host=~"$host", instance="$instance", service_name="$service"} | json | path!="" | path!="/metrics" | path=~"$route" | method=~"$method" | status >= 400 | line_format `{{.status}} {{.method}} {{.path}}  {{.latency_ms}} ms  client={{.client_ip}}  req={{.request_size_bytes}}B resp={{.response_size_bytes}}B`

{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", filename=~"/var/lib/docker/containers/.+"} |= "[GIN]" | json log="log" | line_format `{{.log}}` | regexp `\[GIN\] (?P<ts>[^|]+)\|\s*(?P<status>\d{3})\s*\|\s*(?P<latency>\S+)\s*\|\s*(?P<client_ip>\S+)\s*\|\s*(?P<method>[A-Z]+)\s+"(?P<path>[^"?]*)` | path!="/metrics" | path=~"$route" | method=~"$method" | status >= 400 | label_format level=`{{ if ge .status "500" }}error{{ else if ge .status "400" }}warn{{ else }}info{{ end }}`, detected_level=`{{ if ge .status "500" }}error{{ else if ge .status "400" }}warn{{ else }}info{{ end }}` | line_format `{{.status}} {{.method}} {{.path}}  {{.latency}}  client={{.client_ip}}  [stdout {{ substr 27 39 .filename }}]`

spec.description: Each request that returned 4xx or 5xx. Query A: structured /var/log/ai/vibranium_access.log (since 2026-10-07 17:11 UTC). Query B: vibranium's [GIN] stdout lines, marked [stdout <container-id>]. Gin logs the raw URL, so a route filter on a templated route (e.g. :batch_id) only matches the structured log. Unmatched-route 404s are not written to Gin stdout; see the traces panel for them.
spec.title: Failed requests (status ≥ 400) — access log

spec.query: {resource.service.name="$service" && resource.host=~"$host" && kind=server && name=~"$route" && span.http.method=~"$method" && (span.http.status_code >= 400 || status = error)} | select(span.http.status_code, span.http.method, span.http.target, span.http.client_ip)

spec.description: Server spans that returned ≥ 400 or were marked as errors. Expand a row (›) to see the status code, method and requested URL (http.target); click a Trace ID to open the trace. Unmatched-route 404s are named 'HTTP <METHOD> route not found', so they appear only when route = All.
spec.title: Failed requests — traces

spec.expr: {host=~"$host", instance="$instance", service_name="$service"} | json | path!="" | path!="/metrics" | path=~"$route" | method=~"$method" | latency_ms >= $slow_ms | line_format `{{.status}} {{.method}} {{.path}}  {{.latency_ms}} ms  client={{.client_ip}}  req={{.request_size_bytes}}B resp={{.response_size_bytes}}B`

{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", filename=~"/var/lib/docker/containers/.+"} |= "[GIN]" | json log="log" | line_format `{{.log}}` | regexp `\[GIN\] (?P<ts>[^|]+)\|\s*(?P<status>\d{3})\s*\|\s*(?P<latency>\S+)\s*\|\s*(?P<client_ip>\S+)\s*\|\s*(?P<method>[A-Z]+)\s+"(?P<path>[^"?]*)` | path!="/metrics" | path=~"$route" | method=~"$method" | latency >= ${slow_ms}ms | label_format level=`{{ if ge .status "500" }}error{{ else if ge .status "400" }}warn{{ else }}info{{ end }}`, detected_level=`{{ if ge .status "500" }}error{{ else if ge .status "400" }}warn{{ else }}info{{ end }}` | line_format `{{.status}} {{.method}} {{.path}}  {{.latency}}  client={{.client_ip}}  [stdout {{ substr 27 39 .filename }}]`

spec.description: Requests at or above the slow_ms threshold, from the structured access log (A) and vibranium's [GIN] stdout lines (B). Both record the exact latency, so values are not capped at 10 s.
spec.title: Slow requests (≥ $slow_ms ms) — access log

spec.query: {resource.service.name="$service" && resource.host=~"$host" && kind=server && name=~"$route" && span.http.method=~"$method" && duration >= ${slow_ms}ms} | select(span.http.status_code, span.http.method, span.http.target, span.http.client_ip)

spec.description: Server spans slower than slow_ms. Open a trace to see where the time went.
spec.title: Slow requests (≥ $slow_ms ms) — traces

spec.expr: {host=~"$host", instance="$instance", $log_source} |~ `(?i)$search` | json | path!="/metrics" | path=~"$route" or path="" | line_format `{{ if .log }}{{ regexReplaceAll "\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m" .log "" | trim }}  [stdout {{ substr 27 39 .filename }}]{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}`

spec.description: Free-text / regex search (Log search box). Default source 'all' searches both. 'ai app log files' covers /var/log/ai/* (vibranium access and application logs, route filter applies). Source 'docker stdout' covers raw stdout of every container on the host. Vibranium's [GIN] lines live there, but those streams carry no container label, so search for the path or status you want, e.g. `token/refresh` or `\| 4\d\d \|`.
spec.title: Log search — $log_source

spec.expr: max(100 * (1 - sum by (host) (netdata_mem_available_MiB_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance"}) / sum by (host) (netdata_system_ram_MiB_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance"})))

spec.description: 1 − MemAvailable / MemTotal. Page cache that the kernel can reclaim counts as free.
spec.title: RAM used

spec.expr: sum by (le) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", job="$service", method=~"$method", path=~"$route", path!="/metrics"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: How many requests fell into each latency bucket over time (route and method filters apply).

sum by (host, index, product_name, uuid) ({__name__=~"netdata_nvidia_smi_gpu_frame_buffer_memory_usage_.+_average", host=~"$gpu_host", dimension="used"})
sum by (host, index, product_name, uuid) ({__name__=~"netdata_nvidia_smi_gpu_frame_buffer_memory_usage_.+_average", host=~"$gpu_host"})

100 * sum by (host, index, product_name, uuid) ({__name__=~"netdata_nvidia_smi_gpu_frame_buffer_memory_usage_.+_average", host=~"$gpu_host", dimension="used"}) / sum by (host, index, product_name, uuid) ({__name__=~"netdata_nvidia_smi_gpu_frame_buffer_memory_usage_.+_average", host=~"$gpu_host"})
max by (host, index, product_name, uuid) ({__name__=~"netdata_nvidia_smi_gpu_temperature_.+_average", host=~"$gpu_host"})
max by (host, index, product_name, uuid) ({__name__=~"netdata_nvidia_smi_gpu_power_draw_.+_average", host=~"$gpu_host"})
max by (host, index, product_name, uuid) ({__name__=~"netdata_nvidia_smi_gpu_clock_freq_.+_average", host=~"$gpu_host", dimension="sm"})
max by (host, index, product_name, uuid, pstate) (label_replace({__name__=~"netdata_nvidia_smi_gpu_performance_state_.+_average", host=~"$gpu_host"} == 1, "pstate", "$1", "dimension", "(.*)"))

spec.expr: max by (host, index, product_name, uuid) ({__name__=~"netdata_nvidia_smi_gpu_utilization_.+_average", host=~"$gpu_host"})

spec.description: Frame-buffer memory used as % of each GPU's total (nvidia_smi.gpu_frame_buffer_memory_usage). The inventory table shows the bytes.

spec.expr: max(100 * sum by (host, mount_point) (netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension="used"}) / sum by (host, mount_point) (netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{host=~"$host", instance="$instance", dimension=~"used|avail"}))

spec.description: Highest used % across all mounts, computed like `df` (used / (used + avail)). See the Disks table for each mount.
